steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Ahhhh how can you tie up the Blacksmith? Let go of me! I want to go back to Ladatom! I don't want to meet Draco...!
After wrestling with Mess for some time, you finally tie her up and take her to Draco's cavern on a wooden cart.
It's funny. In the real world, she can easily knock you to the ground, but here she can't defeat "you." Does she subconsciously view herself as someone weak because of her fear of Draco?
Still, when you force her to go meet Draco, she doesn't regard you as an enemy and tries to expel you from the dream like Roulecca did. She doesn't seem to dislike you that much.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You're not the Hero! You're just a big jerk!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no Hero. This is your dream. You've always feared the Dreadlord of Darkness. The dream creates a Hero to face him on your behalf.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Here, there's no Sacred Sword. Nor is there Draco.
You stop the cart. Draco is right in front of you. It's been a few hours, and Draco has forgotten the shame of being beaten by you again. He has regained the confidence of the Great Dreadlord.

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: Roar... It's you again! And the Blacksmith who makes swords!

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Ahhhhh Sacred Sword! Sacred Sword!! Where's the Sacred Sword?!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The Sacred Sword is in my hand.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: O mighty Hero! Please, slay him! The Sacred Sword is in your hand! You can do it!!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Smash the Sacred Sword in front of her

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Ahhhhhh my poor Sacred Sword! What are you doing, you stupid Hero?! I don't want to die with you! It's over! We're going to die!!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Defeat Draco with your bare hands

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: Arghhh...!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content:
Helpppp!
...Huh?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You just... Huh??

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's the 33rd time I defeated Draco with my bare hands, and the 7th time I smashed your invincible Sacred Sword.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Is this... what the Hero is supposed to be like? Is this... the Hero's power?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm much weaker than you in real life, but I can easily break the Sacred Sword and slay the Dreadlord because they are even weaker than me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this really the weapon you've devoted your entire life to forging? Is he really the enemy you need to fight with all your strength?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...That's... so weird... It shouldn't be like this...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This is just a specious dream.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said before that "Only a blade sharpened by darkness can cut through darkness." Likewise, only willpower seasoned by fear can become courage.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But Ambrosia filters out all your darkness and fears, weaving a sweet dream that is just a façade. This is a fake Sacred Sword slaying a fake dragon. It takes away the meaning of your sword-making.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you forge swords just to play this kind of childish game?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: No... Of course not... The enemy I need to defeat can't be this weak...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: It's the most terrifying monster in the world. Not only is it evil, but it also makes those around it evil... It brings malice to everyone...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: The world wasn't this messed up before. People shouldn't be hurting others... It's all its fault...

Your words are starting to have their intended effect. Mess mumbles to herself with her head down. At the same time, the ground, the pillars, and even Draco's body start to show cracks. The world created by Ambrosia is collapsing.
But unlike in Roulecca's dream, terrifying black smoke pours out of Draco's body as the dream collapses. In this half-conscious half-dreaming state, the shocking black goo is remolding its body.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: I want weapons... The best weapons... I want them to disappear...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Kill him, torture him, make him disappear, hehehe, come, give me weapons, help me...
This is malice... Is this the darkness in Mess's heart that had been kept out of the dream?

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: ...My strength... My strength is coming back to me... My malice... is back!!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Yes, this is more like it... The world isn't that innocent. Everyone wants to hurt others. Everyone has been corrupted by malice... This is the world I know...
You try to pull Mess behind you, but she shakes off your hand and steps forward.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: There's no one by my side. No one is going to be my Hero... The real me has always been alone, fighting against Draco's malice all by myself. Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Berserk Monster
steps.content: Become my malice or perish! Your...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hahahahaha!! I'm really incredible!!

Before Draco finishes roaring, the girl lets out a hysterical laugh. Her eyes are bright and her spirit is burning, it's as if she has been given a new life. She smacks Draco's forehead and slams it to the ground.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: This is what I want to slay! This is the malice I want!
Blinding light emits from her palm. Mess extracts a huge amount of dark substance from between Draco's brows, forming a pitch-black sword.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: There are no heroes in this world. I am my own Hero! I forge my own Sacred Sword!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I'm going to defeat you with your own malice!
